text_block_list.text:
It's time for training, but Симболи Рудольф
is
nowhere to be found. Curious, I make
my way to
the student council office.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Zzz... Mm... Oh... Эйр Грув... It's you...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, I find her dozing amid
stacks of
paperwork.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No... I don't need that chair moved...
Heh... Chair
move... Эйр Грув...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's sleeping peacefully,
so I decide
not to disturb her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Please accept my earnest apologies for
failing to
keep to our schedule.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Just be more careful next time.

text_block_list.text:
Of course. I will take pains to ensure
that this
does not happen again.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
